bibl.title: Posting a public notice on papyrus: a frequent phenomenon?
bibl.seg: Paul Schubert, Posting a Public Notice on Papyrus: A Frequent Phenomenon?
bibl.note: Introduction. - The Peukestas order [P. Saqqara Inv. 1972 G.P. 3 = S.B. XIV, 11942]. - Orders to post a notice. - Notices for posting and their copies. - Stone vs. papyrus. - Writing the notice. - Language and script. - Accessibility. - Speed and duration of posting. - Responsibility for posting. - Conclusion: the Peukestas order, an exceptional case of posting on papyrus.
